note: Straight-alpha RGBA layers, far to near. Each PNG includes the overscan margin; place its top-left at `offset` in painting coordinates. depth: suggested parallax factor (0 = sky ... 1 = nearest). flat.png = all layers composited with normal blending.

layers.name: sky
layers.note: golden sky in the gap; opaque

layers.name: canopy_far
layers.note: the highest canopy around the gap: translucent backlit leaf masses (warm near the gap, cool and dark away from it), sky holes, a layer of glowing haze

layers.name: trunks
layers.note: trunks converging toward the zenith; haze shafts and glowing air between the storeys

layers.name: canopy_mid
layers.note: crowns of the converging trees (translucent, backlit) and dark branches and twigs in silhouette reaching into the gap

layers.name: canopy_near
layers.note: near leaf masses and twigs at the frame edges, backlit, varied rims

layers.name: flare
layers.note: soft painted sun glow at the gap edge (animate opacity); no starburst
